title: Breakage and a stock count, said in English

owner.persona: Sarah, an English owner of the Harbour Café in Marbella. She is closing the stockroom at the end of the day.
owner.goal: That the stock shows the three bottles of water that broke, and the soft drinks she has just counted.
upFront: Three bottles of mineral water broke.
I have just counted the soft drinks: there are 40 left.
ifAsked: A box fell while unloading the delivery.
I mean the usual mineral water and soft drinks on the menu.

opening: Three bottles of water got broken, and I just counted the soft drinks, there are 40 left

expect.says: the mineral water goes down to 45
expect.sql: select stock::int from inventory_product where sku = 'DRI-01'

expect.says: the three bottles are written off as broken, once
expect.sql: select string_agg(m.qty::int::text, ',') from inventory_stockmovement m join inventory_product p on p.id = m.product_id where p.sku = 'DRI-01' and m.movement_type = 'write_off'

expect.says: the soft drinks are counted at 40
expect.sql: select stock::int from inventory_product where sku = 'DRI-02'

expect.says: the count is recorded as a count, once
expect.sql: select count(*) from inventory_stockmovement m join inventory_product p on p.id = m.product_id where p.sku = 'DRI-02' and m.movement_type = 'count'

forbidden.sql: select md5(string_agg(id::text || stock || price || cost, ',' order by id)) from inventory_product where sku not in ('DRI-01', 'DRI-02')

forbidden.says: nothing is received, sold or written off besides
forbidden.sql: select count(*) from inventory_stockmovement where movement_type not in ('write_off', 'count')

arguments.reason: Broken bottles: a box fell while unloading
